source.license: NO_DATASET_LICENSE_DECLARED_IN_SOURCE_CARD; research evaluation only pending rights review

sample.composition: 270 taxonomy-cue-stratified rows (15 preassigned rows per label) plus 90 deterministic natural-domain rows
sample.candidateSelection: Deterministic SHA-256 ranking after fixed text-quality, one-row-per-author, lineage, and exact cue rules; no model or prior evaluation output
sample.hardCases: Never remove a selected row for ambiguity, difficulty, abstention, or annotation outcome

taxonomy.cardinality: 0-2; prefer one; zero for neutral, factual, ambiguous, or insufficient evidence
taxonomy.semantics: Exactly the locked petalpal-gemini-blind-v1 definitions; writer emotion only; distinct useful secondary emotions

annotation.adjudication: Every disagreement receives a new independent gemini-3.6-flash request using text, fixed rules, and both rationales; final may equal neither

exclusions: Any normalized-text SHA-256 in the existing 45,345-row historical lineage reference
Any recoverable author ID or source-group ID in historical lineage
Duplicate normalized text or duplicate author within this evaluation
Non-English-like, URL-dominated, fewer than 40 or more than 220 words, or lacking first-person markers
Current model predictions, embeddings, scores, errors, logits, old Dev error cases, and all holdout semantics

metrics.primary: 18-label selected-output Macro-F1, all labels retained, zero_division=0, fixed threshold 0.35 and unchanged max-two selector
metrics.uncertainty: Report author-level bootstrap intervals; labels below 15 support invalidate sealing rather than being removed

usage.firstPermittedEvaluation: Exactly one preregistered candidate chosen without this asset after the asset is SEALED
usage.promotion: Candidate must exceed the preregistered baseline Macro-F1 and retain Micro precision >=0.50; this asset may choose at most one candidate per declared development cycle
usage.repeatedTuning: forbidden; after one candidate comparison, retire this asset from model selection and reserve it for reporting/audit

seal: SEALED only after all 360 final annotations, lineage PASS, unique-author PASS, source manifest hashes, support>=15 for every label, and lock metadata are complete; otherwise NOT_SEALED and no model may evaluate it
